title: Netanyahu's Nuclear Warning, and the Bomb Israel Never Admits
description:
This week Netanyahu warned that an Iranian bomb would mean a "second Holocaust". Israel has never confirmed its own: by early 1967 it had finished its first deliverable nuclear weapon, built in secret at Dimona in the Negev desert.

After its 1948 independence, Israel launched a covert program to develop nuclear weapons, partnering with France and hiding reactors in the Negev desert. Decades of secrecy ended in 1986 when Mordechai Vanunu leaked photos, exposing the Dimona facility and sparking international controversy. This documentary examines how the hidden arsenal shaped regional power and the ongoing policy of strategic ambiguity.

Does Israel have nuclear weapons?
